BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: VI
BRANCH: CHEMICAL   SESSION : SP/2020

SUBJECT: CL6007 POLYMER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
6. Tables/Data hand book/Graph paper etc. to be supplied to the candidates in the examination hall.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Write down principle of Compression moulding. [2]
 (b) Neatly sketch a hydraulic compression moulding machine and show different parts of it. [3]


Q2 (a) Explain the term “stress induced crystallinity”. [2]
 (b) Give two examples of polymers which show high degree of shrinkage during injection
moulding. Why do these materials show such behaviour?
[3]


Q3 (a) Classify polymers on the basis of branching. Give examples of each kind.  [2]
 (b) What are the different types of blow moulding techniques possible with thermoplastic
material and how can you recognize a blow moulding technique used to manufacture a
given product?
[3]


Q4 (a) Differentiate between transfer and compression moulding. [2]
 (b) Why can’t we manufacture transparent polypropylene bottles by normal blow
moulding? What is the modified method to be used to do so?
[3]


Q5 (a) How does a plasticizer function? Give two examples of it. [2]
 (b) Compare between the water soluble polymers poly vinyl alcohol and xanthan.  [3]


Q6 (a) Classify fillers on the basis of the source. Give at least one example of each. [2]
 (b) Write down the degradation reaction of rubber in presence of air. Suggest a stabilizer
for the sample.
[3]
